title: BUG-102-001 Test-Only Fault-Profile Registry (v1)
description: Closed machine-readable schema for the production-inert, test-only fault-profile registry owned by BUG-102-001 (JOURNEY-016 / SCN-102-001-12). Every profile declares the closed nine-field schema; consumers reference profiles by immutable stableId only.

version.description: Registry schema version. v1 is the only supported version.

posture.description: Deployment posture the registry declares. The registry is test-only; a production posture is forbidden.

productionExposure.description: Production exposure declaration. Fault profiles are production-inert; production exposure is forbidden.

profiles.description: The set of fault profiles. At least one profile is required.

journey.description: The owning product journey the fault targets. Closed enum.

setup.description: Deterministic fixture/state setup for the fault in a disposable stack.

teardown.description: Deterministic teardown restoring the disposable stack.

expectedRequest.description: The real first-party request the profile provokes.

expectedResponseOrTermination.description: The real response or clean termination it must produce.

evidence.description: The permitted value-safe evidence class for the profile.

noFirstPartyInterception.description: Explicit assertion that the fault is produced by real stack behavior, never page.route/context.route/route.fulfill/first-party request interception. Must be true; a profile that could only be produced by intercepting a first-party request is invalid.
